stories.headline: Murray Takes a Spill, Wentz Saddles Up in Minnesota
stories.read: Kyler Murray got knocked loco in the first quarter against Green Bay, concussion protocol, ruled clean out for Week 2. Carson Wentz rides in as the emergency horse against the Bears, but Doc's word is don't panic-sell your Jefferson, Hockenson, or Addison shares -- word from the ranch is Murray's expected back in the saddle September 27 at Tampa Bay. If you're desperate for a QB rental this week, Wentz is thin gruel, but there's better game on the open range.

stories.headline: Mason's Busted Wing Throws Open the Gate for Aaron Jones
stories.read: Jordan Mason fractured his thumb after leading the Minnesota backfield with 15 totes in the opener, and now he's laid up on IR for a month. That hands the whole haul to Aaron Jones Sr. -- a veteran ridin' into a bell-cow workload in a run-first outfit. If the rest of your league is still asleep at the wheel, go stake that claim before the saloon catches wise.

stories.headline: Rams Lose Their Best Gun -- Every Offense on Their Schedule Just Got Richer
stories.read: Myles Garrett's headed under the knife for a scoped-out knee and won't be back in the saddle for at least four weeks, straight to injured reserve for Los Angeles. That's the Rams' top pass rusher out of the corral, so any quarterback or pass catcher squarin' off against L.A. the next month just got a friendlier showdown. Bump those matchups up your streamin' list, and if you're leanin' on the Rams' defense, might be time to let it graze on someone else's bench.
